scope: Retail 414510 orb motion including 42c310 nearest-target selection, target flags, orbit radius/anchor/angular rate, staggered detachment, atan2/sqrt, steering speed clamps, out-of-bounds slowing, native 403cd0/403df0 movement, retained linear z, hundredth-pixel floor, delta history and rate-sensitive clock.
